# External samples

Store what a sensor received from the surroundings. A microphone recording belongs here even when the sound came from the robot. A contact reading belongs here when it measures pressure against an outside surface. The device, channel, position and units give each reading its meaning.

Use one sample note per bounded file, packet batch or individual reading. Keep original media beside its note and link to the full filename, including its extension. A small scalar reading can live directly in the note with its original units. Keep any crop, transcript, object label or interpretation with the percept that produced it in `02 Experience/Percepts/`.

Put the device's capture time in the note even if the file arrived later. Use an opaque slug when a descriptive filename would reveal a person's identity. Record any retention limit so that a future reader can account for evidence that has expired.
